subject: Combined credits + extension request for Pivotech PoC
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@pivotech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request — extra credits + 60d PoC extension

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Pivotech is excited to test Redwood in a live PoC. We hit an internal delay on security sign-off and that pushed our startdate back by ~3 weeks. That loss of runway means we won't be able to complete the PoC within the standard 30-day trial.

We have two asks to keep momentum:
- Can Redwood extend the PoC window to 60 days?
- Can you provide an additional 75,000 free inference credits applied to the PoC (to cover higher token volumes during our evaluation)?

If you can combine a trial extension with the credit grant, Procurement is willing to move quickly on an enterprise pilot agreement and discuss a committed-first-year discount (they've asked us to surface a 20% list-rate credit as a potential incentive).

I've attached a short one-page PoC plan and the security contact for procurement. Happy to hop on a call.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Data Platforms
Pivotech Analytics
attachments: poc_plan.pdf (pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@pivotech.com>
Date: 2028-08-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request — extra credits + 60d PoC extension

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and for sharing the PoC plan. We can usually offer a 30-day trial with up to 25k complimentary credits for standard PoCs. A 75k credit grant and 60-day extension would require an exception sign-off.

I will escalate to Sales Ops and RevOps for an exception. To help move this, can you confirm:
1) expected monthly tokens during the PoC (approx),
2) target expansion signal (what would make this a win for Pivotech), and
3) any procurement timing constraints for signature?

If Procurement is willing to commit to a 12-month pilot within 90 days of PoC completion, that will strengthen the case for a larger incentive.

I'll circle back with an internal ask and proposed MOU.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Exec exception request — Pivotech: 75k credits + 60d extension + 20% FY1 discount (PV-2028-081)

Marissa / Rishi — quick ask. Pivotech (new logo, Fortune 500-ish data platform) has requested a combined package to preserve momentum: 60-day PoC extension, 75,000 free inference credits, and they have asked us to surface a potential 20% first-year discount contingent on a 12-month pilot commitment.

Why I recommend a grant:
- Strong TAC (data platform) with clear expansion signals: 3 business units lined up for evaluation after PoC; initial ARR upside estimated at $420k ARR if pilot converts.
- Competitive urgency: they're evaluating two vendors and procurement has limited windows before quarter close.
- Legal delay caused start slip — not their fault; extension keeps the opportunity alive.

Ask:
- Approve exception to policy for combined credit + extension (75k credits, 60d).
- Approve introductory discount up to 20% for FY1, to be capped / ratified by Finance if we proceed to contract.

Attached: draft MOU and a simple pricing model I prepared. If we approve, I'll send an updated MOU and DocuSign link and loop procurement.

Attachments: mou_pivotech.docx, pricing_model.xlsx

Appreciate a quick response — Procurement is hoping to finalize incentives by close of week.

Thanks,
Neha
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec exception request — Pivotech: 75k credits + 60d extension + 20% FY1 discount (PV-2028-081)

Neha — thanks for the context and the attach. A few thoughts before I greenlight:

1) Precedence: 75k free credits is above our standard PoC cap; I'd be comfortable approving 50k to avoid setting a broad precedent.
2) Extension: 60 days is reasonable given the delay. Approveable.
3) Discount: 20% is steep for a first-year rate card for a new account. Recommend capping at 15% with a conditional step-up to 20% if they hit explicit MRR/usage milestones in Q1 post-pilot. Finance would like specific metrics (commit $ or usage threshold).

If you can revise the MOU to a 50k credit grant, 60d extension, and 15% FY1 discount with a milestone clause (50% of the difference to 20% released if they hit $X committed ARR within 90 days), I can approve in Sales Ops and route to RevOps for final ratification.

I've attached the redlines in pricing_model.xlsx. Also need the following before final sign-off: region (US/EU), target contract length, and whether any special data residency or security commitments are required.

pricing_model.xlsx (see sheet: pivotech_redlines)

-Marissa
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec exception request — Pivotech: 75k credits + 60d extension + 20% FY1 discount (PV-2028-081)

Thanks for flagging this. I reviewed the business case and agree with Marissa's compromise. Approve the following exception:

- PoC extension: 60 days
- Free credits: 50,000 inference credits applied to PoC
- Introductory FY1 discount: 15% off list, with an earn-down clause to 20% (additional 5%) if Pivotech hits $300k committed ARR within 90 days of pilot completion

Conditions:
- Final MOU must include the milestone clause and be routed to Finance for ratification on revenue recognition language.
- Deal must be logged in HubSpot (use deal ID PV-2028-081) and the credits applied via billing ticket prior to DocuSign signature.

Neha — please update the MOU, attach the redline, push the DocuSign link, and include procurement@pivotech.com. Marissa: happy for you to route to RevOps/Finance after Neha updates docs.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
